title: It was a fine affair, but now it’s over 😭 #Broadway #BroadwayBen #Mus...
transcript: I have been putting off making this video for a while because to be honest, I've just been in denial that this app could be going away. Uh, I'm still pretty much firmly in the denial stage, despite the fact that it is starting to feel very, very real that tomorrow this app will just be on. And maybe it won't. Maybe it will be magically saved in the last minute. Who knows? But if it does go away, I feel like I would be missed if I did not say 1. Thank you all for watching and engaging with my content and 2. Where to find me next? Right now the plan is to hard pivot to Instagram and just keep posting the same type of content that I was posting on TikTok on reels. I do have a YouTube. I've posted a couple of shorts there, but to be honest I don't think I'll be using it much. I am toying around with pivoting to more long form content on there, but if that does happen it'll probably be a month or two out. So for now the absolute best place to follow me is Instagram. This platform has changed my life. And part of the reason why I have been in denial for so long is because it's genuinely hard for me to imagine my life without this app. I hope that we are able to continue these conversations on other apps, but if not then I just wanted to once again say thank you so much for watching and for changing my life.
classificationReason: This is about TikTok potentially being banned and where to find the creator next, not about any specific theater production
